rule: Per day the LATEST archived edition named for that day is used - the last official word before tip-off - and only its rows whose Game Date equals that day. 'On the floor' means the official box score printed minutes for that player; 'held out' means the page lists them without minutes or omits them, and an omission is never read as confirmation. Status words are the report's own.
